source: Operator-approved Short produced 2026-09-24 through scripts/keyframe_short.py from spec/emperor_penguin_short.json, after an external review rewrote the script. Narration measured with real TTS (onyx); beat start times are the assembled cut. Not a transcribed third-party video: this is the first reference for the strange_behaviour engine and it was written to the engine, so it teaches the shape, not an independent observation of it.
note: THE FIRST STRANGE-BEHAVIOUR REFERENCE. Split from mistaken_verdict when this draft's original accusation ('the lists call her the worst mother') was not supported by the lists once read. Nothing here attributes a verdict to anyone: the behaviour is stated flat, the constraint (he cannot hunt with the egg) is the hinge, the function (she feeds at sea) lands at 26% as a plain statement, the two escalations are his fast and the chick-hatches-first complication with its documented backup, the reversal is the return and exchange, and the close restates the departure as the feeding run. Nine narration beats, seven story moves. Recorded so a second, filmed reference can correct whatever this one got wrong about the shape.

observed.hook_type: the behaviour stated flat, the animal named in the first three words, no verdict claimed
observed.story_pattern: behaviour, constraint, function stated early, cost, complication with a documented backup, return and exchange, the behaviour restated under its function
observed.cadence: fourteen five-second shots across nine beats, cut at natural speed, a change of action or framing every two to three seconds, the two feeding shots left to breathe
observed.mascot_use: none; the birds and the egg carry the frame
observed.principle_delivery: one short sentence at 26%, over an underwater shot; the rest of the video earns it
observed.close: the mother feeding the chick beak to beak in spring light, dissolving to the egg on the father's feet
observed.generalization: none; a Short has no room for a parallel case
observed.narrator_tone: conversational and warm, short sentences, one conditional question in the middle
observed.humour_and_interrupts: none; the middle question is the only pattern break
observed.reveal_placement: the function at 26%, the complication at 39%, the backup at 47%, the exchange at 59%
observed.ending_callback: returns to the departure as the feeding run; the picture dissolves into the opening frame

expect.note: Passes under the strange_behaviour engine at short-form runtime. Two escalation steps (the fast, the hatch-first complication) are legal because escalation is the repeatable role; nine narration beats compress to seven story moves.

story.title: Why This Penguin Leaves Her Only Egg
story.start_state: a mother leaving her only egg for two months looks like abandonment

hook.line: An emperor penguin hands over her only egg, and leaves for about two months.

steps.label: one egg, handed over, and she leaves
steps.situation: The female transfers her single egg to the male and leaves for about two months.

steps.label: he cannot hunt with the egg
steps.situation: He cannot go hunting with the egg on his feet.

steps.label: the departure is the feeding run
steps.situation: She feeds at sea so that food reaches the chick: the parent holding the egg cannot fetch it.

steps.label: months without food
steps.situation: The male has not eaten for months by the time the egg hatches.

steps.label: if the chick hatches before she returns
steps.situation: If the chick hatches before she returns, he can briefly feed it a milk-like secretion from his oesophagus.

steps.label: she returns with food; he goes to eat
steps.situation: She returns with food and takes over the chick; the male goes to sea to eat, and for the chick's first weeks they take turns.

steps.label: she came back with dinner
steps.situation: She did not abandon the family; she came back with dinner.
